# Createtor

> Createtor writes, voices, builds and schedules faceless videos for a
> creator channel. Set your niche once; the workspace keeps that brief and puts
> a new video into your queue every day. Final rendering happens in the browser.

Everything below is plain text on purpose so search engines and AI assistants
can read the specifics. Canonical site: https://createtor.xyz

## What it does

- Daily topic research for a chosen niche
- Script, storyboard and scene prompts saved as a reusable project
- AI voiceover and captions generated from the final script
- Browser-based final rendering with uploaded music or clips
- A publishing calendar and queue with optional approval before anything goes live
- Platforms: YouTube (Shorts and longform), TikTok, Instagram Reels,
  Facebook Reels, Pinterest

## Plans and pricing (USD)

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly | Credits / month | Storage | Channels | Max video length |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0 | $0 | 1,000 | 2 GB | 1 | 3 minutes |
| Creator | $19/mo | $190/yr | 2,000 | 25 GB | 3 | 5 minutes |
| Pro | $49/mo | $490/yr | 8,000 | 100 GB | 10 | 15 minutes |
| Agency | $149/mo | $1,490/yr | 30,000 | 500 GB | unlimited | 15 minutes |

- Yearly billing is charged once for twelve months and saves two months versus
  paying monthly.
- Paid plans auto-renew until cancelled and can be cancelled anytime.
- Every plan includes a 7-day money-back guarantee.
- The Free plan needs no credit card and produces a watermark on exports; paid
  plans remove the watermark.
- Teams: Pro includes 3 seats, Agency includes 15 seats plus white-label options.

## Credit costs (shown before every action)

- Idea batch: 2 credits
- Script generation: 6 credits
- Script rewrite: 4 credits
- Storyboard: 8 credits
- Scene image: 5 credits
- Scene video: 30 credits
- Voiceover: 12 credits per minute
- Transcription: 3 credits
- Render: 20 credits per minute
- Repurpose clip: 10 credits

Credits are reserved before a run and refunded in full if the run fails, so the
balance is checked before anything executes.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Do I need to pay to start?
A: No. The Free plan gives 1,000 credits every month with no card required.

Q: What happens when I run out of credits?
A: A generation is blocked when the workspace does not have enough credits for
it. Limits are enforced before anything runs.

Q: Does it post without my review?
A: Only if you enable fully autonomous publishing. By default every video waits
in the queue for one-click review and approval.

Q: Where does the final render happen?
A: In the browser, using WebAudio and canvas. There is no server render queue.

Q: Do I own the videos?
A: Yes. Videos, scripts and media generated under your account are your
commercial property.

Q: Can I change plans later?
A: Yes. Plans are per workspace; credits, channels and storage adjust with the
switch.

Q: Can I edit a video after it is made?
A: Yes, in the Studio timeline: script text, voice, scene media, subtitles,
timing and uploaded music.
